subject: OliveTech onboarding: tenant provisioning & access playbook
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OliveTech onboarding: tenant provisioning & access playbook

Hi Sarah —

Congrats again on the contract — excited to get you into a tenant this week. I wanted to kick off the handoff to our implementation team with the minimal set of items we'll need to provision your org and get the API test tenant ready. I've attached a draft SOW and an access matrix that matches the roles we'll create on the tenant.

Quick summary (what we need from OliveTech to proceed):
- Confirm primary admin: name + email for the org_admin account (this user will receive the first invite)
- Preferred region for hosted instances: us-west-2 or us-east-1
- IP allowlist ranges for API access (CIDR) or confirmation you'll use IP-less with SAS keys
- Service account for automated workloads (email or name) and whether it should be project-scoped or org-scoped
- Procurement timing for the signed SOW / PO (gives us a firm start date)

We will:
- Create a production-namespace-like tenant for testing and invite two users (org_admin + project_admin)
- Pre-provision two API keys (labelled staging-install and ci-integration) and hand them to your DevOps after you confirm the service account
- Share an onboarding checklist with step-by-step instructions to create roles and generate SSO metadata if you opt for SAML

Proposed timeline: once we have the admin contact + region + PO confirm, we can do tenant provisioning within 48 business hours and schedule a 60-minute setup call to validate API keys and role permissions.

Attachments: olivetech_sow_v1.pdf, access_matrix.xlsx

Thanks — looping in Marissa (CSM) and Dev (implementation lead) so they can pick up the technical coordination.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Subject: Re: OliveTech onboarding: tenant provisioning & access playbook

Thanks Rafael — great outline. A few clarifying items from our side:

- Primary admin: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@olivetech.com> (I'll accept the invite)
- Preferred region: us-west-2 (low latency for our SFO users)
- IP allowlist: we'll provide our CIDR ranges for API access; meanwhile we'd like to use service-account keys for CI.
- Service account: devops@olivetech.com is the account we'd like for automated jobs; please make it project-scoped.
- PO: procurement needs ~7 business days after SOW sign-off; we can provision a staging tenant before PO completes if you require it.

Question: for API keys you provision, what rotation policy do you recommend out of the gate? Also, can you confirm which built-in roles map to the "project_admin" and "monitoring" roles in your access matrix?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@olivetech.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech onboarding: tenant provisioning & access playbook

Hi Sarah — Marissa here from Customer Success. Thanks for the quick reply and the details — this is perfect. Below is a concise provisioning playbook with explicit next steps and responsibilities. I've also attached the onboarding_checklist.md which includes the link to our console UI screenshots.

Mutual action plan (who does what):
1) OliveTech (you):
   - Confirm IP CIDRs by EOD Mon (we'll place them into the tenant allowlist before API keys are handed over)
   - Provide signed SOW or confirm staging allowed before PO (we can proceed with staging without PO)
   - Add devops@olivetech.com as the service account contact for key distribution

2) Redwood (Marissa / Dev):
   - Provision tenant in us-west-2 and create org: OliveTech-prod-staging
   - Create roles: org_admin, project_admin, monitoring_viewer (mapping below)
   - Pre-provision API keys: staging-install (scoped to project) and ci-integration (scoped to service account)
   - Post initial provisioning: schedule 60-min kickoff with devops (walk API key install, rate-limit defaults, and request routing)

Role mappings (defaults we'll apply unless you request changes):
- org_admin: full org settings, invite users, billing visibility
- project_admin: deploy and manage projects, create API keys, configure routes
- monitoring_viewer: view metrics, logs, and tracing; no key creation rights

Security notes:
- Initial keys will be marked for rotation after 30 days. We recommend rotating keys every 30-90 days; for CI you can enable short-lived ephemeral keys (we'll provide the workflow).
- If you opt for SAML SSO (recommended), provide metadata and the SSO admin contact; otherwise invites will be standard email invites.

Proposed dates:
- Tenant provisioning window: Wed Nov 30, 2026 (provision)
- Kickoff meeting: Thu Dec 1, 2026 10:00 AM PT (60 minutes) — Marissa to send calendar invite after confirm

Attachments: onboarding_checklist.md, access_matrix.xlsx

Action items for this thread:
- Sarah: confirm IP ranges + PO cadence (reply to thread)
- Rafael: update HubSpot record with procurement timeline (deal OLV-2026-045)
- Marissa/Dev: prepare tenant template and role definitions

Thanks — we'll keep the provisioning gated on the items above. If you'd like us to provision earlier for testing, say the word and we'll carve out a short-lived staging tenant.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Technical Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
